title: Warehouse Receipt and Stored-Grain Insurance Provisions by Storage Programme
content:
A negotiable warehouse receipt passes title to grain standing in a licensed house, and the cooperative issues one only on the programmes of Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements whose catalogue entry allows it. This page posts which programmes allow it, what issuing and cancelling cost, and where the member's own stored-grain insurance certificate is called for.

## Provisions by programme

| Programme | Receipt may be issued | Issuance charge (USD) | Insurance certificate required before a receipt | Cancellation charge (USD) | Insurance certificate required to open the agreement |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Open Storage Account | no | 0.00 | no | 0.00 | no |
| Grain Bank Deposit Account | no | 0.00 | no | 0.00 | no |
| Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage | yes | 35.00 | yes | 20.00 | yes |
| Seasonal Paid-Up Storage Agreement | yes | 35.00 | yes | 20.00 | no |
| Conditioned Reserve Storage Agreement | yes | 35.00 | yes | 20.00 | yes |
| Identity Preserved Segregated Storage | no | 0.00 | no | 0.00 | yes |

## Points of judgement for the desk

**The two insurance columns are not the same requirement.** One is the certificate the catalogue calls for before the agreement itself is accepted into store; the other is the certificate the catalogue calls for before a receipt is issued against the grain. The Seasonal Paid-Up Storage Agreement calls for no certificate to open but does call for one before a receipt; the Identity Preserved Segregated Storage calls for one to open and issues no receipt at all.

**Where a receipt may not be issued the charges stand at nil.** The three programmes that issue no receipt post 0.00 for issuance and 0.00 for cancellation, which records that the service is not carried rather than that it is free.

**Where a receipt may be issued the charges are uniform.** All three programmes that issue receipts charge 35.00 to issue and 20.00 to cancel.

## Hypothetical illustration

A member holding grain under a Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage whose stored-grain insurance certificate is on file meets both insurance columns, and a receipt issued and later cancelled against that grain would carry 35.00 and then 20.00. The same member's bushels on an Open Storage Account fall under a programme whose catalogue entry does not allow a receipt at all.
